systems.system: CNIE system (with its Automatic Fingerprint Identification System)
systems.platform: AFIS from an unnamed vendor, with a proprietary fingerprint template on the card
systems.owner: Direction Générale de la Sûreté Nationale (DGSN), within the Ministry of Interior
systems.tiers: About 100 enrolment centres (CEDI) of a planned 120; back-end systems in place since 2008

note: The passages describe the police-run national identity card and its fingerprint de-duplication, a civil identity system; criminal records appear only as a database said to carry the card number, and nothing on how stations record reports or cases is stated.
